stepTitle: Adding more features (i.e., exceeding $$30$$ parameters) yields a unique OLS solution.
stepBody: The owner collects $$n$$ $$=$$ $$30$$ observations and fits an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) model with $$29$$ features (e.g., foot traffic, temperature, etc.) with an intercept (30 parameters total). The model is:\n$$\hat{y}_i $$=$$ \hat{\theta}_0 + \hat{\theta}_1 x_{i1} + \hat{\theta}_2 x_{i2} + $$\cdots$$ + \hat{\theta}_{29} x_{i29}$$\nWhich of the following is always true?
